about: Round 71: lifecycle transitions sent as PATCH, the method the PAP serves for them (PR #42, comment of 2026-10-26 15:44Z); the transitions of rounds 48 to 66 went as POST and answered 500. Each case uploads a set in a tenant of its own (one case in the default tenant), sends transitions with no body, decides after each and deletes its sets last.

cases.about: Control: an ACTIVE set uploaded in a tenant of its own, decided and read back.

A set uploaded INACTIVE, then activate sent as POST, as rounds 48 to 66 sent it, and as PATCH: the status of each, the decision after each and the export read back, where the set holds ACTIVE after the PATCH or what it held before.

A set uploaded ACTIVE, then deactivate sent as POST, as rounds 48 to 66 sent it, and as PATCH: the status of each, the decision after each and the export read back, where the set holds INACTIVE after the PATCH or what it held before.

A set uploaded ACTIVE, then draft sent as POST, as rounds 48 to 66 sent it, and as PATCH: the status of each, the decision after each and the export read back, where the set holds DRAFT after the PATCH or what it held before.

A set uploaded ACTIVE, then archive sent as POST, as rounds 48 to 66 sent it, and as PATCH: the status of each, the decision after each and the export read back, where the set holds ARCHIVED after the PATCH or what it held before.

A set uploaded DRAFT, then activate as PATCH: the stand owner's probe answered activate and archive from DRAFT with 400 "Can't change policy set status from 'DRAFT' to ..."; the decision and the export after it.

A set uploaded DRAFT, then archive as PATCH: the stand owner's probe answered activate and archive from DRAFT with 400 "Can't change policy set status from 'DRAFT' to ..."; the decision and the export after it.

A set uploaded DRAFT, then deactivate as PATCH: the stand owner's probe answered activate and archive from DRAFT with 400 "Can't change policy set status from 'DRAFT' to ..."; the decision and the export after it, then activate.
An ACTIVE set moved to DRAFT by a transition, then activated: whether a DRAFT the transition wrote refuses activate as an uploaded DRAFT does.
An ACTIVE set activated, then deactivated twice: a transition to the status the set holds.
A set uploaded ARCHIVED, then activated, and one archived by a transition, then deactivated: whether an archived set comes back.
An ACTIVE set with an INACTIVE nested set allowing UPDATE, activated, deactivated and activated again: the nested set's status read back and the decision on UPDATE after each.
A set whose only rule a CUSTOMER customization moves from UPDATE to READ, deactivated and activated: whether the customization outlives the transitions.
A transition that names a nested set's id: deactivate, then the decision on the operation only the nested set allows and the export read back.
A set deactivated through its policySetId in upper case.
A transition of a set before it is uploaded, then the upload INACTIVE, then the same transition: an unknown id, and the order of a transition against the write it depends on.
Transitions the route does not know, sent as PATCH: parity-unknown, then Deactivate and DEACTIVATE; the decision and the export after the last.
Deactivate and activate as PATCH in the default tenant, under an externalId of its own: the same transitions as the cases in tenants of their own, in case the PATCH depends on the tenant.
Control: an ACTIVE set uploaded in a tenant of its own, decided and read back.
